title: Identify operating, investing, and financing activities, and the statement of cash flows format

items.concept: Classify operating, investing, and financing cash flows; record initial recognition and disposal/settlement JEs; prepare subsequent cash-section schedule reconciling beginning to ending cash; present formal SCF format
